label: warm-2026-09-23
note: Hot-cache repeats are not a full cold start: a rebooted machine and a
first-ever binary read are outside what this harness can automate.
Each sample uses a fresh isolated data root, so the data layout is cold
while the OS file cache for the application bundle is warm from the
previous repeat. Treat the first repeat of a session as the coldest.
Launch 1 of each sample is the cold start; launches 2-3 reuse that data root and are steady-state starts (first-run layout and bootstrap registration already done).
桌面冷启动的回归护栏，不是提速目标。数值来自 2026-09-23 的基线样本（每 profile n=5，另有一次 normal n=15 的复测），
取整到 10 ms 并留出约 1.3-1.5 倍余量，用于发现明显回退；样本量不足以支撑高分位统计，因此不能用它宣称性能达标。
spawnToLocatorMs 不设护栏：基线本身在 640-990 ms 之间波动，这个量级内无法区分回退与噪声。
budgetsMs 同时约束冷启动（每次样本的第 1 次启动）与稳态启动（--launches 的第 2 次及以后）的观测最大值；
warmVsColdMs 是额外的中位数差护栏：稳态启动不得比首次启动慢超过该余量，用于发现「每次启动都重做首次工作」这类回退。
unmeasured: 系统重启后的完全冷启动
